summary: Frontend-only E2E of Phase 7 (Triage → Booking → Prescriptions). All 8 acceptance flows pass end-to-end. (1) /chat as omar.patient renders full-width triage-card for the mild rash screening with all sub-testids populated: triage-level='No visit needed for now', triage-headline (self_care sentence), triage-reasons (bulleted finding-cited reasons), triage-watch-for, triage-self-care, triage-specialty 'Suggested: General practice', and triage-book-btn. Clicking it navigates to /book?report=report_6efc1ffb82c5&specialty=General%20practice&reason=Small%20itchy%20rash%20on%20forearm with booking-reason-input prefilled to 'Small itchy rash on forearm'. (2) Direct /book renders book-visit-page and lists Dr. Layla Haddad first with my-doctor-badge 'YOUR DOCTOR' and clinic-phone-<id> link '+966 11 555 0199' (Internal medicine · Al Noor Medical Centre · Riyadh). Clicking show-slots-<user_b1000ae5aad6> revealed slots-<id> grouped by day (102 chips across 14 days). Clicked slot-2026-08-22T06:30:00+00:00 (labelled '09:30'), got success toast 'Booked with Dr. Layla Haddad — Sat 22 Aug · 09:30' and redirected to /dashboard. Re-opening /book and expanding Layla shows 101 slots and the picked slot is gone (booked slot removed). (3) Specialty filter: typing 'Dermatology' + booking-search-btn → no-doctors empty state; clearing + search returns Layla with my-doctor-badge. (4) Doctor login at /auth/clinician (dr.layla) → /settings shows availability-card with 7 pre-published weekly blocks; add-availability-block-btn adds an 8th (Wed 14:00→17:00), slot-minutes-select changed 30→20, save-availability-btn shows toast 'Your clinic hours are published — patients can book these times.' Reload persists 8 blocks and slot_minutes=20. (5) /doctor/schedule shows 33 encounters; opened the newly booked enc_7cd0fcddb4ba (Aug 22, 06:30 UTC = 09:30 Riyadh). Scrolled to prescription-writer and filled rx-drug_name-0=Amoxicillin, rx-strength-0=500 mg, rx-dose-0=1 capsule, rx-frequency-0=three times daily, rx-quantity-0=21; add-rx-item-btn added item 1 with Tramal 50 mg (controlled). save-rx-btn saved draft → toast 'Prescription saved as a draft'; rx-controlled-1 badge appears on the Tramal line. sign-rx-btn (confirm accepted) → toast 'Prescription signed and sent to the patient' and rx-signed-badge appears; rx-drug_name-0 becomes disabled (locked). (6) rx-pharmacy-select lists 2 partner pharmacies; selecting Nahdi and clicking transmit-rx-btn shows a visible info toast 'Tramal: Controlled medicine — dispensed in clinic, never sent online' (visible in screenshot) and rx-transmitted-line 'Sent to Nahdi Pharmacy on 8/20/2026, 3:12:50 PM'. (7) Patient side: sidebar nav-prescriptions opens /prescriptions (prescriptions-page). Newest card shows Dr. Layla · Al Noor Medical Centre · signed 8/20/2026 · 'Sent to Nahdi Pharmacy', Amoxicillin + Tramal (with 'In clinic only' badge on Tramal), download-rx-<id> PDF button and order-rx-<id>. Clicking order lists 2 proposals; Amoxicillin (not in seeded catalog) becomes proposal-blocked-0 with reason 'No partner pharmacy lists this medicine…', Tramal becomes proposal-blocked-1 with 'Controlled medicine — collect it at the clinic…'. To validate the offer path we opened an older Concor+Tramal prescription: proposal-0 (Concor) lists BOTH pharmacies with Nahdi Sponsored first at 42.5 SAR and Al Dawaa second at 39.95 SAR (sponsored-first ordering confirmed even though Al Dawaa is cheaper); proposal-1 shows proposal-blocked-1 for Tramal (no offers). Clicking confirm-offer-item_ef3667adcd05 added to basket and redirected to /pharmacy. (8) Regression: /dashboard, /medications, /visits, /pharmacy, /pharmacy/orders, /prescriptions all load; nav-book and nav-prescriptions render for patients. Only 2 console errors observed total across all runs: pre-login /notifications polls returning 401 (harmless, session-cookie race — see minor note).
critical_code_review_comments: PrescriptionWriter.transmit() success toast in the code is 'Sent to {pharmacy.name_en}…' — good — but the `unmatched` info toasts (e.g. controlled Tramal notice) fire immediately AFTER the success toast on the same click; because the test spec asks for a distinct info toast, the observed behaviour is fine (visible on screen) but the two toasts share the same anchor and the info toast can be cut off if the doctor navigates away quickly. Consider raising toast.info duration for controlled-medicine notices.

Prescriptions.jsx: when a prescribed medicine is NOT in the partner catalog (e.g. Amoxicillin here), the proposal renders `proposal-blocked-N` with reason 'No partner pharmacy lists this medicine — search the pharmacy page instead.' That is correct behaviour. But the same testid `proposal-blocked-N` is now used for TWO very different states (unavailable vs controlled). Downstream analytics/tests may want to distinguish them — consider `proposal-unavailable-N` vs `proposal-controlled-N`.

BookVisit useEffect uses `specialty` param on initial load only (empty deps). If a user opens /book?specialty=General%20practice from TriageCard and the doctor's real specialty is 'Internal medicine', Layla is filtered out on first render and my-doctor-badge disappears — the patient may think they have no doctor. Suggest either (a) always show 'Your doctor' block above the filtered list, or (b) softly fallback: if 0 doctors match specialty, retry without specialty and show a hint 'No cover for General practice — showing your own doctor'.

AvailabilityCard has no client-side validation for start<end and no overlap check across blocks — backend covers this per the request, but a friendly inline error before Save would prevent a wasted round-trip.

TriageCard emergency branch renders `Call {emergency_number}` but the reasons/watch-for/self-care sections still render below the header — consider hiding non-actionable sections in an emergency to keep the eye on the 997 button. Cosmetic.

Two console errors seen at the very start of testing were /api/notifications 401s. These come from Layout polling on the /auth screen before session cookie is set. Guard the notifications poll behind an authenticated flag or ignore 401 silently to keep the console clean.

Doctor availability now has 8 weekly blocks (existing 7 + Wed 14:00-17:00) with slot_minutes=20. Basket has 1× Concor 5mg from Nahdi (added via confirm-offer flow on older prescription).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 7 (triage + booking + prescriptions) is fully green E2E. Note: seeded catalog only carries Concor/Panadol/etc — if writing new prescriptions to exercise confirm-offer, use drug names that exist in the partner catalog (Concor / Panadol Extra). Layla's availability was extended to 8 blocks during testing (Wed 14–17 UTC+3 @ 20-min slots) — if this breaks future tests, PUT /api/doctor/availability to restore to 7 blocks. Two /api/notifications 401 console errors on /auth are cosmetic (pre-auth poll).
rca of the issue: No functional issues found. Only cosmetic/code-review observations noted above.
